title: regression_context
description: Output of the backend regression scope resolver (scope.json). Resolves requested services against the per-module regression index (e.g. gofood.regression.json) and returns the existing BrowserStack cases plus the TestNG selectors that cover them. Scoped by SERVICE, not by feature: any change to a service has blast radius across that service and the impacted services its index declares. Field names are camelCase, matching the emitted file.

module.description: Test code module the scope was resolved in, e.g. 'driver-platform'. Matches team_registry code.module.

indexFile.description: Per-module mapping file the scope was resolved through, e.g. 'driver-platform.regression.json'.

caseIdNamespace.description: Where the numeric case ids originate, e.g. 'testrail'. The same number is rendered by BrowserStack as either 'TC-{n}' or 'C{n}' — see testCases[].id.

requestedServices.description: Service names asked for. The caller supplies the service under change; the index expands it to impacted services.

resolvedServices.description: One entry per successfully resolved service. testGroups and testClasses are the executable selectors for the signoff run.

service.description: The name it resolved to in the index.

testCaseIds.description: Bare numeric case ids covering this service.

testGroups.description: TestNG groups — what CI runs for the signoff.

testClasses.description: Test class simple names. Note: class-level only — no method names, so a case cannot be traced to a specific method from this file alone.

unlinked.description: Methods carrying no @TestInfo case id. They exist but can never be matched to a case — a coverage-quality signal, not an error.

unresolvedServices.description: Requested services the index could not resolve. Never silently dropped.

testCaseIds.description: Union of bare numeric case ids across all resolved services.

testCases.description: Case detail fetched from BrowserStack. Only id, name and projectId are available — there is no status, priority, endpoint, method or requirement linkage in this file.

id.description: BrowserStack case id verbatim. BOTH 'TC-{n}' and 'C{n}' renderings occur within a single project — in one real driver-platform scope, 298 cases used TC- and 61 used C. Any join must strip both prefixes, or it silently drops the other form.

name.description: Case title. NOT unique — in the same real scope, 61 of 359 cases shared a title and 20 were identical. A weak matching signal that cannot disambiguate on its own.

steps.description: Execution steps for this case. OPTIONAL — present only when the resolver fetched them. When present they are the strongest matching signal available in this file: they disambiguate cases that share a title, which titles alone cannot. Preferred source is the repo (what actually runs) when an automated counterpart exists; otherwise BrowserStack's human-written steps, which may be thin or empty.

stepsSource.description: Where steps came from. 'repo' = derived from the automated counterpart, so it reflects what executes. 'browserstack' = the human-written case steps, which describe intent and may have drifted from the code. The distinction matters: only repo-sourced steps are evidence about what a test asserts.

expectedResults.description: Expected result per step, positionally aligned with steps[] where the source provides them. Carries the assertions a case makes, which is what reveals an assertion becoming insufficient after a contract change.

items.description: Case detail fetched from BrowserStack. id, name and projectId are always present. steps/expectedResults are optional and, when present, upgrade matching from weak title similarity to behaviour-level. There is still no method, endpoint or requirement linkage in this file.

unmatchedTestCaseIds.description: Ids present in testCaseIds for which BrowserStack returned no case detail.

browserstack.description: Fetch outcome. Read this before trusting an empty or short testCases[] — a failed fetch and genuinely-no-coverage look identical otherwise.

fetchedCases.description: Total cases pulled from the project before filtering to the requested services.
